command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-01 pre-mutation survey. READ ONLY. Nothing here starts, stops, installs or
# changes anything. Its job is to establish, freshly, the four things the migration plan depends on:
# whether a native Windows Ollama already exists, who currently owns port 11434, what the P40's
# power/thermal state actually is right now, and whether this session can even do the work.

Write-Output '--- IDENTITY ---'
Write-Output "hostname=$env:COMPUTERNAME"
Write-Output "whoami=$(whoami)"
Write-Output "now_utc=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output "boot_utc=$((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
$id = New-Object Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent())
Write-Output "is_elevated=$($id.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator))"
Write-Output "is_admin_group=$((Get-LocalGroupMember -Group 'Administrators' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ',')"

Write-Output '--- GPU-NOW ---'
$smi = 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe'
Write-Output "nvidia_smi_present=$(Test-Path $smi)"
& $smi --query-gpu=uuid,name,driver_model.current,driver_model.pending,persistence_mode,power.limit,power.default_limit,power.max_limit,temperature.gpu,power.draw,memory.total,memory.used,driver_version --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output "GPU_RC=$LASTEXITCODE"

Write-Output '--- P40-ECC-NOW ---'
& $smi -i GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2 -q -d ECC | Select-String -Pattern 'Ecc Mode|Current|Pending|Volatile|Aggregate|SRAM Correctable|Total' | Select-Object -First 24 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }

Write-Output '--- NATIVE-OLLAMA-PRESENT ---'
$cmd = Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "ollama_on_path=$([bool]$cmd) path=$($cmd.Source)"
foreach ($p in @(
        "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Ollama\ollama.exe",
        "$env:ProgramFiles\Ollama\ollama.exe",
        "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Ollama\ollama.exe",
        'C:\Users\bs\AppData\Local\Programs\Ollama\ollama.exe',
        'C:\HermesLab\ollama\ollama.exe',
        'D:\HermesServices\ollama\ollama.exe',
        'G:\ollama\ollama.exe')) {
    Write-Output "candidate $($p) exists=$(Test-Path $p)"
}
Write-Output '--- OLLAMA-EXE-SEARCH ---'
foreach ($root in @('C:\Users\bs\AppData\Local\Programs', 'C:\HermesLab', 'D:\HermesServices', 'G:\', 'C:\Program Files')) {
    if (Test-Path $root) {
        Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Filter 'ollama.exe' -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Depth 4 |
            ForEach-Object { "FOUND $($_.FullName) bytes=$($_.Length) mtime=$($_.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o'))" }
    }
}

Write-Output '--- WINDOWS-SERVICES-OLLAMA ---'
Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'ollama|llama' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'Ollama' } |
    Select-Object Name, DisplayName, Status, StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 160
Write-Output '--- SCHEDULED-TASKS-OLLAMA ---'
Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match 'ollama|hermes|p40|gpu' } |
    Select-Object TaskName, TaskPath, State | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 160

Write-Output '--- PORT-11434 ---'
$c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 11434 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($c) {
    $c | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, State, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120
    $c | ForEach-Object { "pid=$($_.OwningProcess) proc=$((Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName)" }
} else { Write-Output 'NO_LISTENER_11434' }
Write-Output '--- PORT-11435 ---'
Write-Output "listener_11435=$([bool](Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 11435 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))"

Write-Output '--- OLLAMA-PROCESSES ---'
Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'ollama' } |
    Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 160

Write-Output '--- OLLAMA-ENV-MACHINE ---'
foreach ($v in @('OLLAMA_HOST', 'OLLAMA_MODELS', 'OLLAMA_ORIGINS', 'OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE', 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES', 'OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL')) {
    Write-Output "machine:$($v)=$([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v, 'Machine'))"
    Write-Output "user:$($v)=$([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v, 'User'))"
}

Write-Output '--- DOCKER-STATE ---'
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Ports}}|{{.Image}}' 2>&1
Write-Output "DOCKER_RC=$LASTEXITCODE"

Write-Output '--- COMPOSE-DIGEST ---'
Write-Output "compose_sha256=$((Get-FileHash 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\docker-compose.yml' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Write-Output "compose_mtime=$((Get-Item 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\docker-compose.yml').LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o'))"
Write-Output '--- START-HERMES-PS1 ---'
Write-Output "start_sha256=$((Get-FileHash 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\start-hermes.ps1' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Get-Content 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\start-hermes.ps1' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Output '--- HERMESLAB-FILES ---'
Get-ChildItem 'C:\HermesLab\hermes' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTimeUtc | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120

Write-Output '--- DISK-FREE ---'
Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter } | Select-Object DriveLetter, @{n = 'FreeGB'; e = { [math]::Round($_.SizeRemaining / 1GB, 1) } }, @{n = 'SizeGB'; e = { [math]::Round($_.Size / 1GB, 1) } } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 80

Write-Output '--- NODE-AND-NET ---'
Write-Output "node=$(node --version 2>&1)"
try {
    $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://ollama.com/download/ollama-windows-amd64.zip' -Method Head -TimeoutSec 25 -UseBasicParsing
    Write-Output "ollama_zip_head=$($r.StatusCode) length=$($r.Headers['Content-Length'])"
} catch { Write-Output "ollama_zip_head_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }
try {
    $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/ollama/ollama/releases/latest' -TimeoutSec 25 -UseBasicParsing
    $j = $r2.Content | ConvertFrom-Json
    Write-Output "ollama_latest_tag=$($j.tag_name)"
    $j.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -match 'windows' } | ForEach-Object { "asset $($_.name) bytes=$($_.size)" }
} catch { Write-Output "gh_release_ERR=$($_.Exception.Message)" }

Write-Output '--- MODEL-STORES ---'
foreach ($s in @('D:\HermesData\ollama', 'G:\HermesData\ollama')) {
    if (Test-Path "$s\models\blobs") {
        $m = Get-ChildItem "$s\models\blobs" -File | Measure-Object -Sum Length
        Write-Output "$s blobs=$($m.Count) bytes=$($m.Sum)"
    } else { Write-Output "$s NO_BLOBS" }
    if (Test-Path "$s\models\manifests") {
        (Get-ChildItem "$s\models\manifests" -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($s.Length) }) -join ' ; '
    }
}
